item.description: Broken, not dead: Phileia #1685 (plague). The Reapers carry the pieces to Asphodel.

item.title: Like Aethalides, who passes between the living and the dead, Phaidion #5406 the Twice-Born
item.description: Like Aethalides, who passes between the living and the dead, Phaidion #5406 the Twice-Born rose from Asphodel and returned to the Field of Ares. Phaidion has drunk from Lethe 2 times and remembers little.

item.title: Alkmenes #9627 keeps returning to it: a child's death. It has changed them.
item.description: Alkmenes #9627 keeps returning to it: a child's death. It has changed them.

item.title: Demion #3532 the Twice-Born carved Hippnikos #7087's name into a rib-bone and gave it away
item.description: Demion #3532 the Twice-Born carved Hippnikos #7087's name into a rib-bone and gave it away. They walk together at dusk now.

item.description: An insult, a fist, blood in the Field of Ares: Hermion #8125 the Twice-Born and Eurkrates #4191.

item.title: The fire under Dorkles Distratides ~1010 has gone out. The bones were gathered and an oar
item.description: The fire under Dorkles Distratides ~1010 has gone out. The bones were gathered and an oar was planted on the mound in the Asphodel Meadow.

item.description: Klestratos #49 the Twice-Born was broken and is whole again (1×). The Argyreoi made room at the fire, but no one sat close.

item.title: Dorkles Distratides ~1010 died of the fever. The herbalists had no more of the Prometheion
item.description: Dorkles Distratides ~1010 died of the fever. The herbalists had no more of the Prometheion to sell.

item.description: Ikarlaos #98 of the Gegeneis fell (plague). Their bones go to the Asphodel Meadow to mend.

item.description: An insult, a fist, blood in the Reef: Kallmedes #4800 Siren-deaf and Kleos #5436 the Twice-Born.

item.title: Kleos #5436 the Twice-Born was broken and is whole again (2×). The House of Udaeus made ro
item.description: Kleos #5436 the Twice-Born was broken and is whole again (2×). The House of Udaeus made room at the fire, but no one sat close. Kleos has drunk from Lethe 2 times and remembers little.

item.title: Andreia #8929 the Twice-Born was broken in the archipelago (fell in the war of Burning Lak
item.description: Andreia #8929 the Twice-Born was broken in the archipelago (fell in the war of Burning Lake of Eridanus's freedom). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.

item.title: Hippnikos #7087 swore by the Styx to repay Archias #1180 the Blood-handed in blood. They h
item.description: Hippnikos #7087 swore by the Styx to repay Archias #1180 the Blood-handed in blood. They have stopped eating with the family.

item.title: Archias #1180 the Blood-handed took refuge at the altar and clasped Hippnikos #7087's knee
item.description: Archias #1180 the Blood-handed took refuge at the altar and clasped Hippnikos #7087's knees there. Hippnikos #7087 refused them at the god's own table. The stain of it is on Hippnikos #7087 now. Archias is the cruel now.

item.title: Peisope #2373 the Twice-Born and Lysias #313 fought in Deucalion's Strand. Both limp now;
item.description: Peisope #2373 the Twice-Born and Lysias #313 fought in Deucalion's Strand. Both limp now; neither will forget. Their houses had broken bread as guest-friends.

item.description: Klestratos #49 of the Argyreoi fell (plague). Their bones go to the Asphodel Meadow to mend.

item.description: Demgenes Neoonides ~2508 was born in Bear Mountain to Neoon #6293 and Hippippos #6500, the first Leaf of their line.
